verdicts.reason: A: the Meridian logo has been pulled out of the blue panel, shrunk, and left sitting on the busy green hill. The supporting copy is squeezed into a narrow five-line column jammed against the panel's right edge, and the sunglasses overlap the panel's corner. Its headline, badge and CTA still read left to right with a sizeable button. B: the oversized logo runs into the panel edge (the 'n' touches it) and the sunglasses are cropped at the top. The 'Find a Fare' CTA is shrunk to a tiny pill stuck onto the end of the subcopy, so the action is buried. A is the less broken of the two.
